verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that external sharing exists ('allows users to share content with people outside your organization') and that apps can create sharing links via Graph. Nothing documents admin-side governance: no org-level external sharing toggles, no domain allow/block lists, and no restrictions on link types or expiration. Sharing-link creation is a user and developer action, not an admin control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an IT admin, external collaboration is governed — org-level controls over who can share outside the team, with domain allowlists or link restrictions
